Name: Flip The Trinket
Author: daniquintana
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Flip The Trinket is a simple Content Patcher mod that replaces the vanilla fairy trinket sprite with a much more expressive design!

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
Unzip the mod folder into your Stardew Valley [b]Mods[/b] directory.
Run the game using SMAPI.

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Replaces the vanilla fairy trinket sprite with custom art (pixalated middle finger).[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
SMAPI
Content Patcher

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Thank you Vashti and Cathryn, great farming days ahead of us.[/color][/size]
